back_translation: Thank you for your suggestion! We gladly read every idea. You can view and submit feature requests via our public roadmap at roadmap.roosterly.nl, where you can also vote on ideas. Unfortunately, we cannot promise a delivery date for individual requests.

Good morning Anouk, You can add a new employee by going to Team → Medewerker toevoegen. Enter the name, email address and contract hours there and click on Uitnodigen. The employee will then receive an email to install the app. Kind regards, Roosterly
